sender.title: Sender profile
sender.intro: These details are typed into contact forms on your behalf: businesses will reply to this email and phone number.
sender.jobTitleHint: Example: Sales manager. Some forms ask for it.
sender.emailHint: The address businesses will reply to.
sender.saveFailed: The profile could not be saved. Please try again shortly.
sender.folderNotFound: This client folder no longer exists.
sender.websiteInvalid: Enter a valid website address (example: https://mysite.com).
sender.missingDescription: Fill it in before preparing forms: without it, the robot does not know what to write.

messages.title: Campaign messages
messages.intro: Write up to 4 messages: they are sent in turn to see which one works best. Variables in braces are replaced for each business. If a piece of information is missing for a business (no rating, no reviews…), the sentence containing it is removed automatically.
messages.shortIntro: Some sites limit the message length. This version of at most 200 characters is used instead.
messages.bodyPlaceholder:
Hello,

We took a look at your business's Google profile…
messages.previewDescription: The message as it will be written for three real businesses of this folder.
messages.previewEmpty: No prospect in this folder yet: the preview will appear once a campaign has found some.
messages.previewNoText: Write a message to see the preview.
messages.companyMissingWarning: Your company must appear in the message: insert the “Your company” variable or write its name.
messages.noSenderWarning: The sender profile is not filled in: the preview leaves your details empty.
messages.saved: {count, plural, =0 {Messages saved (none filled in).} one {# message saved.} other {# messages saved.}}
messages.saveFailed: The messages could not be saved. Please try again shortly.
messages.companyMissing: Each message must mention your company (the “Your company” variable or its name).
messages.unknownVariable: A message contains an unknown variable. Check the braces.
messages.shortTooLong: The short version must not exceed 200 characters.
messages.detailCount: {count, plural, =0 {No message} one {# message} other {# messages}}
messages.detailMissing: Write at least one message before preparing forms.
messages.autoValidationPlan: Automatic validation is not included in your plan.

sending.title: Sending
sending.intro: These settings apply to this campaign.
sending.dailyLimitHint: The robot never sends more forms than this number per day for this campaign (your plan also sets a global cap).
sending.autoValidationHint: A form prepared without any warning is validated on its own, without review. Forms to complete or with a remark still wait for your review.
sending.autoValidationPlanHint: Available on the Business and Scale plans.
sending.autoValidationWarning: Warning: automatically validated forms will be sent as soon as sending is active, without your review.

forms.intro: Contact forms filled in by the robot, to review before sending. Nothing goes out without your approval.

groupHints.ready: The form is filled in. Check the screenshot and the message, then validate.
groupHints.incomplete: The site asks for something the robot does not have: open the form and fill it in.
groupHints.intervention_required: The site is protected by a captcha. The robot did not solve it: you can send by hand from the site.
groupHints.validated: Validated by you. The robot sends them during the day, within the campaign's and plan's daily limit.
groupHints.preparing: The robot is working. This list refreshes by itself.
groupHints.no_form: No contact form found. When an email address was spotted on the site, it is saved on the prospect.
groupHints.unreachable: Site unreachable, error, or a send that failed. You can relaunch the preparation from the Prospects page.
groupHints.sent: Forms sent (confirmation seen on the site). One sending credit was debited per form.
groupHints.to_verify: The robot clicked Send but saw no clear confirmation. Look at the after-send screenshot and decide: delivered or not.

forms.emptyHint: To prepare some: Prospects page, tick businesses then “Prepare forms”.

selection.count: {count, plural, one {# form selected} other {# forms selected}}

forms.missingBadge: {count, plural, one {# missing field} other {# missing fields}}

confirm.validateTitle: Validate {count, plural, one {this form} other {these # forms}}?
confirm.validateDescription: They will be sent at the next step, as filled in.
confirm.skipTitle: Skip {count, plural, one {this form} other {these # forms}}?
confirm.skipDescription: They will not be sent. You can relaunch the preparation later.
confirm.excludeTitle: Never contact {count, plural, one {this business} other {these # businesses}} again?
confirm.excludeDescription: Their site joins the folder's suppression list: they will not be contacted again.
confirm.markSentTitle: Mark {count, plural, one {this form} other {these # forms}} as delivered?
confirm.markFailedTitle: Mark {count, plural, one {this form} other {these # forms}} as not delivered?
confirm.markFailedDescription: They will move to “Unreachable / failed”. You can relaunch the preparation later.

actions.skipDone: {count, plural, =0 {No form skipped.} one {# form skipped.} other {# forms skipped.}}

actions.failed: The action failed. Please try again shortly.
actions.updateFailed: The form could not be saved (already validated or sent?).

actions.markFailedDone: {count, plural, =0 {No form changed.} one {# form marked not delivered.} other {# forms marked not delivered.}}

detail.title: Form for {name}
detail.subject: Subject
detail.missingHint: The site requires this information. What you write here will be typed in when sending.

prepare.title: Prepare {count, plural, one {# form} other {# forms}}
prepare.description: The robot opens each site, fills in the contact form and sets it aside. Nothing is sent: you will validate afterwards on the Forms page.
prepare.campaignHint: Some selected prospects come from an import: choose the campaign whose messages will be used.

prepare.noSender: Fill in the sender profile first (Sender menu).
prepare.noMessages: Write at least one message in the campaign first (Messages button).
prepare.capReached: You already have many forms ready to validate. Validate or skip them before preparing more.
prepare.failed: The preparation could not be started. Please try again shortly.
